Guidance & outlook: Referring to Slide Number 16, the FY 27 guidance and outlook.
We have 7 million square feet of potential launches with approximately 6 million square feet planned for FY27 across Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune and Kolkata.
And most importantly, the H2 launch and completions pipeline provides a strong visibility and therefore, confident of achieving FY27 guidance.
Growth & demand: We achieved our highest ever Q1 sales of INR 484 crores with sales volume of 0.85 million square feet.
The response to the plotted development launch has been particularly encouraging with approximately 55% of inventory sold within the first 30 days.

During Q1, we launched approximately 0.9 million square feet across 3 launches, 0.3 million square feet at Shriram Stellar in Chennai, 0.4 million square feet at Shriram Southbrook in Kolkata and 0.2 million square feet, Green Meadows in Chennai.
Margins & costs: On P&L front, revenue was INR 271 crores, EBITDA, INR 42 crores and PAT INR 11 crores.
The muted margins are largely product mix driven rather than structure, with around 40% from relatively lower margin legacy projects from Kolkata.
And those are the projects will drive the margin up back to our more comfortable level of mid-20s EBITDA margin and about 9% to 10% PBT margin.
Capex & expansion: Our balance sheet remains healthy, giving us the flexibility to continue investing in new opportunities while maintaining disciplined capital allocation.
This provides ample funding capacity to support future growth.
Therefore, with our strong equity base, healthy liquidity and low gearing, we have sufficient balance sheet capacity to support future growth without taking leverage to uncomfortable levels.
Balance sheet & cash: From the cash flow perspective, we generated INR 135 crores of free cash flow before new project investment, invested INR88 crores in new projects and ended the quarter with a strong liquidity position.
We generated free cash flows before new project investments of INR135 crores and invested INR88 crores in new projects, resulting in net free cash flow of INR47 crores.
The positive net free cash flows improved our closing cash balance to INR219 crores.
Risks & challenges: External environment where we faced challenge in the past has also become a bit more controlled, a bit more stable.

After a bit of a slowdown in pan -India absorption in December quarter last year, the subsequent quarterly reports seem to suggest that they're all gr owing between 5% and 8%, of course, each city has their own rate.
But sustenance sales prices are going up by 4%, 5%, not more than that, which is good enough to capture the inflationary pressure if there are any in the cost side.

Guidance & outlook: Improved visibility on regulatory performance, further strengthens our outlook for FY27.
The approval process has already commenced for all 7 projects acquired during the year, and we expect over 7 million square feet to be added to the launch pipeline over the next 3 to 6 months.

Our guidance includes sales volume of 5 -5.5 million square feet during FY '27, sales value of INR3,300 -3,500 crores, collections of INR2,100 - 2,200 crores, handovers of 3,750 - 3,800 units, pipeline addition of 7-8 million square feet, GDV addition of INR5,000-6,000 crores.
Growth & demand: For FY '26, sales value for the year stood at INR2,354 crores, registering a marginal increase over the previous year despite delays in certain project launches.

This includes Spectrum, Pune, over 300 units sold during launch year; Songs of the Earth, Bangalore over 85% sold in launch y ear; Skybloo m Villas, Kolkata over 50% sold, Signature Square in Kolkata, approximately 40% sold at launch.
All launch projects have witnessed encouraging sales traction with 30% to 85% of the inventory sold at launch are within the launch year.
